title: Range Characterization of the Weighted Divergent Beam and Cone Integral Transforms
summary: We establish range characterizations, or data consistency conditions, for an integral transform that maps a function to its weighted integrals over conical surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^n$. We consider two different geometries for the cone vertices, which lead to mathematically distinct range conditions. We use the term \emph{conical Radon transform} when the vertex set is a bounded convex subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ including support of the input function.
